name: Heavy Duty Gantry Crane
tagline: Superior quality industrial gantry crane for heavy material handling
description: Safe Build Engineering's Heavy Duty Gantry Crane is manufactured using optimum quality components and sophisticated technology per industry norms. Available in various capacities with cantilever and non-cantilever options, ideal for lifting medium and heavy weight goods up to 100 tonnes.
features: Available in cantilever and non-cantilever option
Lifts medium and heavy goods up to 100 tonnes
High performance, energy efficiency and robust structure
Less maintenance for long working life
Wide span for fast material handling

specs.Class of Duty: M5, M7, M8 as per IS 3177 / IS 807
specs.Crane Control: Pendant push buttons / Radio remote / Cabin with master control
specs.Drive System: Twin drive squirrel cage induction geared motors with fail safe brakes
specs.Power Supply: Trailing cables / drag chain / shrouded bus bars / cable reeling drum
